'''Ramen''' is a leftover food from an earlier version of the pack, separate from [[Tonkotsu Ramen|tonkotsu ramen]]. Its crafting recipe still exists but is never unlocked. It gives {{EffectLink|Regeneration}} for 30 seconds and doesn't use the pack's hidden healing.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/ramen.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A [[bowl]], a [[Glow Berry Mash|glow berry mash]] (the recipe asks for rotten flesh, which the pack renames), an [[egg]], a brown [[mushroom]] or raw porkchop and [[Dried Kelp|dried kelp]].

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Ramen is a renamed rabbit stew that stacks to 16. It keeps rabbit stew's vanilla food values and gives Regeneration I for 0:30, with its icon shown.

== Trivia ==
* The 1.10 changelog says bugged foods from earlier versions were removed, and the 1.12.1-alpha changelog removes outdated green curry and paneer makhani recipes, but this recipe remains.
